added_lines: . what ’s on in our parish: parish surgery —there will be no parish surgery this monday 14th september as canon robert away on retreat. prayer & communion services— on monday 14th and wednesday 16th september by deacon james in dundrum at 9.30am. the service will be lay led on tuesday 15th september. st carlo acutis— many thank to the parishioners who purchased medals, prayer cards and candles. a young gent after mass spoke to canon robert and decon james informing them he had met st carolo acutis ’ mother in paris—how special! parish fundraising concert on friday 18th september –countdown on for this event! parishioners and friends are requested to be seated by 6.45pm please. parish pastoral council members will be available to provided help in carpark and chapel. “helpers ” would be most welcome to come along to tidy chapel on monday 14th september at 7pm and setup community centre on thursday 17th september at 7pm. not too late to purchase ticket! we hope everyone has an enjoyable evening. canon robert —will be away on retreat after mass on sunday the 13th september until wednesday 16th september inclusive. please contact mary polland for any emergencies

750. parish pastoral council meeting— held last tuesday the following was agreed. the 1st anniversary of deacon james ordination will be held on sunday 4th october 2026. following tea and coffee and light refreshments for everyone. parishioners are also welcome to join deacon james and his family for lunch in maginn ’s castlewellan (payable!) please inform annette or mary if you wish to attend and choose menu! october is the month of the rosary and at weekend masses the rosary will be recited (outside, weather permitýng) in ballykinlar at 5.45pm and dundrum at 10.30am. harvest display —parishioners/friends who would like to help with the display please come along to chapel on thursday 1st october at 7pm. your views will be very welcomed! november 2026 —there will only be one mass this year (in november) for all those who have died (or buried) since november 2025 in ballykinlar. date to be confirmed.

the story of the unforgiving servant is a lesson in what faithful forgiveness means. at the heart of forgiveness there is a grace. grace is something that cannot be contained or controlled. grace shows us that where there is real mercy and forgiveness, there is sharing and generosity. put simply it means that if you fully receive the mercy of god, it will compel you to share it, to be kind and merciful to your neighbour. it is a difficult notion to understand it a world, or economy, where we are encouraged to be selfish and greedy and make sure that, 'nobody will make a fool out of me'. time to get real about faith: if you seek and accept god's forgiveness its fruit is the forgiveness you will share with others. (fr s crumptor)
